name: Millet Breakfast Bowl
steps: Rinse millet thoroughly and drain. Pit and chop dates and roughly chop almonds.
Put millet, measured water and salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover loosely and simmer for 18–22 minutes until the grains are tender.
Add milk, dates and cinnamon and simmer gently for 5–8 minutes, stirring until creamy.
Toast almonds in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes and let cool slightly.
Peel and slice banana immediately before serving. Divide warm millet porridge into four bowls.
Top with banana and almonds and serve. Thin with warm milk if the porridge thickens while standing.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
